tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Search hotels on HotelsCasa: more than 1.3 million hotels and apartments in our catalogue (including guest houses and holiday homes) in 44 countries (Europe, Turkey, the Caucasus, Central Asia and Latin America). Search by city (English or local name; add country to disambiguate) or by lat/lng + rad

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: Full details of one hotel from search_hotels by its hotel_key: address, description, amenities, photos, check-in/check-out times, places nearby, a summary of guest opinions and the page url. With check_in/check_out it also checks availability live and returns an `availability` block: available true/

tools.name: search_activities
tools.description: Search tickets, tours and attractions (museums, monuments, day trips) sold on HotelsCasa with our partner Tiqets. Search by city, country code or text. tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Details of one activity by activity_key: description, what is included, duration, cancellation, next available dates with prices, photos and the page url. Always give the traveller the url of every item as a clickable link, unchanged: it is the only way to book or buy.

tools.name: find_flights
tools.description: Link to search and book flights on HotelsCasa. This tool does NOT return live fares: flight prices are searched by the traveller on the page. Returns the flight page for the destination when HotelsCasa has one (108 popular destinations in Europe and the Americas), otherwise the general flight search

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_hotels" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_hotels, get_hotel, search_activities, get_activity, find_flights, partner_with_hotelscasa, search_properties, get_property, check_availability · Private data: partner_with_hotelscasa, search_properties, search_vehicles, get_vehicle, check_vehicle_availability · Public sink: book_ground_transport, search_properties, get_property, check_availability, search_vehicles, get_vehicle, check_vehicle_availability.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_hotels, get_hotel, search_activities, get_activity, find_flights, partner_with_hotelscasa, search_properties, get_property, check_availability · Private data: partner_with_hotelscasa, search_properties, search_vehicles, get_vehicle, check_vehicle_availability · Public sink: book_ground_transport, search_properties, get_property, check_availability, search_vehicles, get_vehicle, check_vehicle_availability

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
